With windows of length L covering the chain, interior links of long windows are not peripheral... but the chain's end links (1,2) and (64,65) are peripheral (node 1 only appears as a start). Peeling would eat the chain from both ends until nothing remains? Let's see: round 1 removes links where one endpoint is always at a path end. For a chain with all windows [i..i+L], link (j,j+1) appears in windows where i ≤ j and i+L ≥ j+1. Is j at a path end in all of them? j is the first element when i=j; j is the last when i+L = j. If there's a window with i < j and i+L > j, then j is interior → not peripheral via j. Similarly for j+1. So for interior links, both endpoints are interior in some window → survives round 1. Then the windows get trimmed at the ends... Each round trims the first/last ASN of paths whose first/last link was marked. To get a large core, I need a topology where every link has both endpoints interior in surviving paths — e.g., a cycle! With C_64 and paths = all 64 rotations of the 64-node Hamiltonian path (i.e., the cycle minus one edge): each path has 64 nodes = 63 links. Then all 64 cycle edges appear... So each edge e=(k,k+1) is missing only from P_k. In all other paths it's present. Is node k interior in some path containing e? And e=(k,k+1) is in P_{k+1}? P_{k-1} = nodes k, k+1, ..., k-1: starts with k, k+1 → k+1 is at position 1 → interior ✓ (as long as the path has ≥ 3 nodes ✓). So e is not peripheral ✓ → all 64 edges are core.

cd /workspace/tmp && cat > perf.py <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng=random.Random(3)
N=64
rib=[]
for s in range(N):
    p=[((s+k)%N)+1 for k in range(N)]
    rib.append({'path':p,'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)})
# extra peripheral chains with disjoint ASNs to fill up record/length budgets
base=10000
used_len=sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib)
while len(rib)<2000 and used_len+20<=40000:
    L=20
    p=list(range(base,base+L)); base+=L
    rib.append({'path':p,'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)})
    used_len+=L
order=[]
for s in range(N):
    a=(s%N)+1; b=((s+1)%N)+1
    order.append([min(a,b),max(a,b)])
priors=[]
seen=set()
pool=[(i,i+1) for i in range(1,300)]+[(base-1-i, base-i) for i in range(1,300)]
while len(priors)<2000:
    a=rng.randint(1,200000); b=rng.randint(1,200000)
    if a==b: continue
    e=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
    if e in seen: continue
    seen.add(e)
    w=[rng.randint(0,1000000) for _ in range(3)]
    if sum(w)==0: w[0]=1
    priors.append({'link':list(e),'weights':w})
declared=[]; seend=set()
while len(declared)<2000:
    a=rng.randint(1,200000); b=rng.randint(1,200000)
    if a==b: continue
    e=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
    if e in seend: continue
    seend.add(e)
    declared.append({'link':list(e),'rel':rng.choice(['c2p','p2p','p2c'])})
ixps=list(range(900000,900000+1024))
queries=[]
for i in range(512):
    s=rng.randrange(N); L=rng.randint(1,64)
    p=[((s+k)%N)+1 for k in range(L)]
    if rng.random()<0.3: p=[rng.randint(1,300000) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,64))]
    if rng.random()<0.2 and ixps: p=p+[rng.choice(ixps)]
    a=rng.randint(0,1000000); b=rng.randint(a,1000000)
    queries.append({'id':'q%03d'%i,'path':p[:64],'threshold':[a,b]})
data={'version':1,'ixps':ixps,'rib':rib,'priors':priors,'declared':declared,'order':order,'queries':queries}
raw=json.dumps(data).encode()
print("records",len(rib),"len sum",sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib),"bytes",len(raw))
open('/workspace/tmp/big.json','wb').write(raw)
t0=time.perf_counter()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
t1=time.perf_counter()
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("time %.2f"%(t1-t0), "rc",p.returncode, "keys",list(out)[:5])
if 'links' in out:
    core=[l for l in out['links'] if l['round']==0]
    print("links",len(out['links']),"core",len(core),"queries",len(out['queries']))
    print("sample core", core[:2])
    print("sample query", out['queries'][0])
else:
    print(out)
EOF
